theme.en: AI Infrastructure Pulls Chips Toward Bandwidth and Integration
theme.zh: AI基础设施推动带宽升级与技术整合

dek.en: Marvell's Lumentum deal and Qualcomm's reported HBC silicon result put data movement at the center of the day's chip news. SK hynix's expansion faces China-related policy friction, while FPGA and handset earnings point to uneven demand.
dek.zh: Marvell收购Lumentum的计划与高通据报取得的HBC芯片验证结果，让数据搬运成为今日芯片新闻的主线。SK hynix扩产遭遇涉华政策阻力，FPGA与手机芯片公司的业绩则显示需求分化。

title.en: Marvell Targets AI Connectivity With Lumentum Acquisition

summary.en: Marvell plans to expand its AI-connectivity portfolio through the acquisition of Lumentum, bringing together electrical and optical interconnect technologies, laser manufacturing, and semiconductor capabilities. The combination would give Marvell a broader role in the links that move data around AI infrastructure. Its significance lies in integrating more of the interconnect supply chain as bandwidth and power constraints shape system design.
summary.zh: Marvell计划通过收购Lumentum扩展AI互连产品组合，整合电互连、光互连、激光器制造与半导体技术能力。此举将扩大Marvell在AI基础设施数据传输环节的业务覆盖。随着带宽与功耗约束影响系统设计，这笔交易的意义在于整合更多互连供应链环节。

title.en: Altera Adds Four Agilex 2X FPGA Families for AI and Embedded Systems
title.zh: Altera新增四个Agilex 2X FPGA系列，覆盖AI与嵌入式系统

summary.en: Altera has expanded its FPGA lineup with the Agilex 2X portfolio, comprising four device families for AI infrastructure, high-speed networking, robotics, industrial automation, and edge systems. The range gives system designers programmable-logic options across data-center and embedded workloads, making performance, power, and software support central to choosing among the families.
summary.zh: Altera推出Agilex 2X产品组合，新增四个FPGA器件系列，面向AI基础设施、高速网络、机器人、工业自动化与边缘系统。这一布局为数据中心和嵌入式工作负载提供更多可编程逻辑选择，各系列的性能、功耗与软件支持将成为系统设计者选型的关键。

title.en: Nordic Combines Wi-Fi and Edge AI in nRF71 SoCs

summary.en: Nordic Semiconductor has introduced nRF71 SoCs combining Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, Thread, and edge AI in a single device. The company claims standby power as low as one-twentieth that of its previous-generation nRF70 Wi-Fi products. The integration targets battery-powered connected devices, where radio standby consumption can materially affect battery life; the claimed reduction applies to standby power rather than total system energy.
summary.zh: Nordic Semiconductor推出nRF71系列SoC，在单颗器件中集成Wi-Fi、Bluetooth LE、Thread与边缘AI。公司称，其待机功耗最低可降至上一代nRF70系列Wi-Fi产品的二十分之一。该系列面向电池供电的联网设备，无线功能的待机消耗会显著影响续航；这一降幅针对待机功耗，并不等同于整机总能耗的降幅。

title.en: Tower and Innolight Advance Near-Package Optics for AI
title.zh: Tower与中际旭创推进面向AI的近封装光互连

summary.en: Tower Semiconductor and Innolight are advancing high-performance near-package optics for AI infrastructure, according to an announcement carried by Quantisnow. Moving optical links closer to compute packages could reduce reliance on longer electrical connections and address interconnect power and reach constraints. Production readiness and deployment scale will determine how much the effort changes AI-system connectivity.
summary.zh: 据Quantisnow刊载的公告，Tower Semiconductor与中际旭创（Innolight）正推进面向AI基础设施的高性能近封装光互连。将光链路移近计算封装，有望减少对较长电连接的依赖，缓解互连功耗与传输距离限制。其对AI系统互连的实际影响，仍取决于量产成熟度与部署规模。

title.en: Qualcomm Validates HBC Silicon With a Reported 18x Bandwidth Gain
title.zh: 高通验证首款HBC芯片，带宽据报为LPDDR5X的18倍

summary.en: Qualcomm has validated its first HBC silicon, with a reported 18x memory-bandwidth gain over LPDDR5X, according to The Futurum Group. The result points to a route for feeding more data to compute hardware, an important constraint on memory-bound workloads. The bandwidth multiple alone does not establish application speedups or energy efficiency, which depend on workload behavior and the complete system.
summary.zh: 据The Futurum Group报道，高通已完成首款HBC芯片验证，其存储带宽据报达到LPDDR5X的18倍。该结果为提高计算硬件的数据供给能力提供了一条路径，针对的是受存储访问限制的工作负载。带宽倍数本身不能直接换算为应用加速比或能效提升，后两者仍取决于工作负载特征和完整系统。

title.en: Wolfspeed Introduces Transparent SiC Substrates for AR and Quantum Applications
title.zh: Wolfspeed推出用于AR与量子应用的透明SiC衬底

summary.en: Wolfspeed has introduced optical-grade transparent SiC substrates targeting AR waveguides and quantum applications, with development progressing toward larger wafers. The move extends SiC into optical uses, where wafer scaling and optical uniformity will shape manufacturing costs and adoption. Progress toward larger substrates is a manufacturing milestone, while commercial output remains a separate question.
summary.zh: Wolfspeed推出面向AR光波导与量子应用的光学级透明SiC衬底，并正向更大尺寸晶圆推进开发。这一布局将SiC拓展至光学用途，晶圆尺寸扩展与光学均匀性将影响制造成本和市场采用。向大尺寸衬底推进属于制造环节的进展，商业化产出规模仍需另行观察。

title.en: SK hynix's New York Chip Plans Hit China-Related Restrictions
title.zh: SK hynix纽约芯片计划遭遇美国涉华限制阻力

summary.en: SK hynix's New York chip plans have hit a snag over U.S. restrictions on China, Reuters reports, citing sources. The reported obstacle adds policy uncertainty to the company's expansion plans and shows that the impact of export controls can extend to investment outside China. The report describes a setback to the plans, with no cancellation established by the available account.
summary.zh: 路透社援引消息人士称，SK hynix在纽约的芯片计划因美国对华限制措施遭遇阻碍。这一障碍为公司的扩产计划增加了政策不确定性，也说明出口管制的影响可能延伸至中国以外的投资。报道描述的是计划受阻，现有信息尚未确认项目取消。

title.en: Skyworks Falls as Smartphone Weakness Weighs on Its Forecast
title.zh: 智能手机市场疲软拖累业绩预期，Skyworks股价下跌

summary.en: Skyworks shares fell as a sluggish smartphone market weighed on the company's forecast, Reuters reports. The weak outlook highlights the sensitivity of handset-related chip suppliers to phone demand, even as AI infrastructure attracts investment elsewhere in the semiconductor industry.
summary.zh: 据路透社报道，智能手机市场低迷拖累Skyworks的业绩预期，公司股价随之下跌。疲弱的展望显示，手机相关芯片供应商仍高度受终端需求影响，即使半导体行业其他环节正吸引AI基础设施投资。

title.en: Lattice Gains 11% on Record Revenue and an Upbeat Outlook
title.zh: 营收创新高、业绩展望乐观，Lattice股价上涨11%

summary.en: Lattice Semiconductor shares gained 11% after record revenue and an upbeat outlook, according to Seeking Alpha. The results provide a positive signal for programmable-logic demand amid the uneven chip-market conditions illustrated by Skyworks' smartphone-related forecast weakness.
summary.zh: 据Seeking Alpha报道，Lattice Semiconductor营收创下新高，业绩展望乐观，带动股价上涨11%。这一结果为可编程逻辑需求提供了积极信号，与Skyworks受手机市场拖累的业绩预期一起，呈现出芯片市场的需求分化。

title.en: SambaNova and Supermicro Plan Systems With 10,000 SN50 Chips
title.zh: SambaNova与Supermicro计划推出搭载10,000颗SN50芯片的系统

summary.en: SambaNova and Supermicro plan systems incorporating 10,000 SN50 chips, according to TOKENPOST. Working with a server vendor could broaden the route to market for SambaNova's inference hardware and make system availability a more concrete test of adoption. The 10,000-chip figure describes a plan, rather than confirmed shipments or installed capacity.
summary.zh: 据TOKENPOST报道，SambaNova与Supermicro计划推出合计搭载10,000颗SN50芯片的系统。与服务器厂商合作，有望拓宽SambaNova推理硬件的销售渠道，而系统实际供货将成为检验市场采用程度的具体指标。10,000颗芯片是计划规模，尚不能等同于已确认出货量或已部署容量。
